claim: The `(null)` cell is a residual bucket, defined where the unit is defined, and the sensitivity of excluding it is reported.
status_note: It was 16.32 percent of the denominator and appeared in no definition anywhere in the package. A residual cell is not one analysis result and is not homogeneous in producer, which is the property the unit is chosen for.
value: 6 of 36 cells carry `(null)`, holding 5,731 of 35,107 objects, 16.32 percent; 4 of the 6 sit inside the headline numerator. Excluding them the ladder reads 21 of 30 against the headline 25 of 36.
floor: not applicable, this row counts analysis-result cells
dropped: the sensitivity is reported in Results 3.2.1c only. It is not in the abstract and not in the cover letter, so one number is in front of a reader and the sensitivity is beneath it

claim: Analysis-result cells are complete for the seven censused classes. For Segmentation they are the identifiers observed in the PRE-06 sample and frame coverage is unmeasured.
status_note: The claim of completeness was stated over every class at four sites while Segmentation is a 5,941 of 190,146 draw, so frame coverage of its cells does not follow from the sample. Restricted at all four.
value: 7 classes censused completely, so their cells are the frame's. Segmentation contributes 17 cells observed in a sample of 5,941 of 190,146 series; whether the frame holds an identifier the sample did not draw is not measured.
floor: not applicable, this row reports coverage of a unit
dropped: frame coverage of the Segmentation cells is unmeasured and is stated as unmeasured rather than assumed. Measuring it needs the full index grouped by analysis result, which is a different query from the one PRE-06 drew

claim: Six defects of one shape were closed by strengthening the assertion that missed each, rather than by correcting the text.
status_note: The previous round moved the headline from 31 cells to 36 and the checks did not move with it. Every strengthened assertion now opens a shipped file rather than a source artefact or a module constant.
value: 11 assertions, up from 10. Strengthened: N-of-M pairs recompute from table 3 across 9 shipped files; figure citation is bidirectional over both copies; placeholder markers are counted from the bytes of every file the manifest names; figure width is tested for membership in {39, 84, 129, 174} mm rather than against a maximum.
floor: not applicable, this row counts assertions
dropped: nothing. The one assertion still failing is the placeholder count, which is blocked by the four author fields and is the gate's job rather than a defect

claim: The six figures are renumbered so that first citation in the body runs 1 to 6 ascending, and each is cited once at its natural anchor.
status_note: Only figure 3 was cited anywhere. Content order in the body ran 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 4, so the floor figure became 4, the adjudication figure 5 and the collection-mass figure 6.
value: 6 of 6 figures cited in both manuscript copies, first-citation order 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
floor: not applicable, this row counts citations
dropped: no prose named any figure by number before this, so the renumbering moved file triples, legend blocks and manifest entries and no sentence

claim: The Word files are produced from a converter pinned in its own virtual environment, and four of the venue's Word-only rules are verified in the produced file.
status_note: The measurement environment is unchanged. env/requirements.lock does not gain a typesetting dependency; env/typesetting/ is a separate virtual environment and results/environment.json records what it is for.
value: 7 of 7 documents converted with pypandoc-binary 1.15 carrying pandoc 3.6.1. Verified in the file: page numbering present, single column, no field functions in the body, body font 10 point. Not verified: typeface, line numbering, and the table rule on documents whose source has no table.
floor: not applicable, this row reports format checks and not a validator rate
dropped: three rules are not verified and are named: the typeface, which the venue gives as an example rather than a requirement; line numbering, which this venue does not ask of a manuscript; and the table rule on the three documents whose source carries no table, where it is out of scope rather than passing
